instructions_to_main_agent: Replace the existing gold/cyan color palette entirely with the dark/steel-blue variables provided in this blueprint.
Remove the existing 3D car showcase. Do NOT include any 3D rendering libraries like React Three Fiber or Spline.
Ensure the copy is English-only. Drop any bilingual Traditional Chinese text from the existing site.
Setup Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root layout level.

Implement the floating glassmorphic nav bar. It should sit over the hero image, shrink slightly or become more opaque on scroll, and feature a mobile hamburger with an elegant full-screen or dropdown menu.

HERO SECTION: Use `hero_bg` image with a dark overlay (`bg-black/60` or similar). Include eyebrow text 'PRECISION MANUFACTURING', heading 'Built to Perform.', and heritage blocks ('EST. 1984 / HONG KONG' and 'MANUFACTURING / DONGGUAN, CHINA') using the `metadata` typography scale. Add subtle CAD-style measurement markings (like crosshairs or coordinate labels) with slight parallax.

CAPABILITIES SECTION: Build a 4-card grid ('Metal Products', 'Plastic Products', 'Custom Manufacturing', 'Quality Assurance'). Use Lucide icons. On hover: card translateY, border brightens, icon scales, and the arrow shifts right.
PROCESS SECTION: 5 stages (01 Inquiry to 05 Delivery). Layout must be horizontal on desktop (with nodes connected by a line) and vertical on mobile.
PRODUCTS SECTION: Large image cards, not small grids. On hover: the wrapper scales up the image slightly, overlay darkens.

QUALITY SECTION: A premium dark section with technical diagrams/lines. Include editable placeholder text for certifications (e.g., 'ISO 9001:2015 [Placeholder]'). Do NOT fabricate fake numbers or awards.
QUOTE FORM: Use Shadcn UI forms. Include standard fields, a drag-and-drop file upload zone (accepting PDF/DWG/DXF/STEP/STL/ZIP), validation errors, and a success confirmation state.
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Build a simple protected route (e.g., /admin) that lists submitted quote requests in a Shadcn Table. Include a detail view modal or side panel. Mock the Google Sign-in if necessary.
FOOTER: Include the brand, slogan 'Precision Engineering Aligned with Excellent Standards', and standard copyright info.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, links, and form inputs for testing.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, avoiding flat or monotonous looks.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements like nav and modals.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition-transform` or `transition-colors` to prevent breaking complex animations.
Avoid centering layouts by default. Left-aligned typography and structured grids feel more professional and readable for B2B technical audiences.
Incorporate micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover states, focus rings, active clicks).
Utilize generous whitespace. Use `py-24` or `py-32` spacing between major sections to let the technical elements breathe.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters. Rely exclusively on clean SVGs (e.g., Lucide React).
Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets APCA or WCAG AA contrast standards.
Make sure form inputs have highly visible focus states with the primary blue ring.
